sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Rail Runner is an endless runner game where you control a character as they navigate through a challenging railway environment. The gameplay is simple yet addictive, requiring you to use your character's speed and agility to avoid collisions, jump over hurdles, and collect valuable coins to upgrade your power-ups. As you progress through the game, the level design will become increasingly challenging, with new obstacles and hazards introduced at regular intervals. But don't worry, you'll have the tools you need to overcome these challenges and reach new heights.

One of the key features of Rail Runner is its use of power-ups, which can be collected and used to enhance your character's abilities. These power-ups can be used to increase your speed, jump height, and even grant you temporary invincibility. With a variety of power-ups to choose from, you'll need to strategically use them to overcome the challenges ahead and reach new heights. As you progress through the game, you'll also unlock new abilities and power-ups, allowing you to tackle even the most challenging levels with ease.

Another key feature of Rail Runner is its use of coins, which can be used to upgrade your power-ups and unlock new abilities. Coins can be collected by running over them or by using certain power-ups to reveal hidden paths. With a variety of upgrades to choose from, you'll need to strategically use your coins to unlock new abilities and power-ups that will help you navigate the increasingly challenging levels ahead.
